title: flow-trace project manifest
description: Optional project manifest at <project>/.flowtrace/project.json. Indexes documents (flows + sequences) by stable id → path (relative to the project root, may point outside it) and a logical, possibly-nested category ('a/b'). If absent, flow-trace falls back to a flat folder scan.

id.description: Stable document id (matches the document's own id). Workspace-unique.

path.description: Path to the document file, relative to the project root. May point outside it.
